Location in the background costs battery, most of all at night when nothing else is going on.
Nothing recorded yet. The service reads Android\'s report every 30 minutes, so the first entries come within half an hour.
No app used these sensors in the last 24 hours.
Tap an app to open its permissions.

Android keeps only the latest access of each kind. Activity+ reads that report every 30 minutes and keeps what is new for 30 days, so a count is the least number of uses: several accesses between two readings show as one. System services are hidden by default. Activity+ never changes a permission.
